evals.prompt: prep me for a meeting about the SIPGN portal incident — the webchat widget thing
evals.expected_output: A 1-page brief covering the SIPGN portal webchat/WA exposure incident. Should include: background (webchat on pre-login page), key decision (MR !1341 takeout), current status (merged/pending revert), people involved (war room team), open questions (revert timing, RCA).
assertions: Background section describes the webchat/portal exposure
Source citations use bracketed [WA: or [MR: format
People Involved section lists at least one person or @lid

evals.prompt: I have a meeting about SIPGN-1700, what do I need to know?
evals.expected_output: A 1-page brief on SIPGN-1700 (FE config promotion). Should cover: what SIPGN-1700 is (role Pemantau-Nasional config), current status (Jira Done but FE config prod promotion unconfirmed), the staleness (7+ days since WA escalation), and MR !1321.
assertions: FE config or prod promotion is mentioned
A staleness warning (⚠️ POSSIBLY STALE or ⚠️ STALE) appears if relevant context is >7 days old
